log.text: Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.8: more of Ship of Harkinian's options: rainbow bridge conditions, Triforce hunt, starting hearts, and ocarina, Weird Egg and Gerudo card shuffles.
Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.7: cows and shop slots can be shuffled. Cows give their item without an empty bottle; shop slots sell their item at the seed's price, once.
Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.6: Gold Skulltula tokens and Deku scrubs can be shuffled. Tokens count from the save, so none is missed.

Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.5: every dungeon's blue warp cutscene can be skipped, the Great Fairies and the Light Arrow cutscene are real checks, and the forest, the Kakariko gate and the Door of Time can start open.

Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.4, the first release with a game executable (a replacement TriAevum.exe for an installed TriAevum beta.1.2): more options (Zora's Fountain and Jabu-Jabu open, rainbow bridge open, Ganon's trials, starting items), the Deku Tree's and Dodongo's Cavern's blue warp cutscenes skipped, and checks that never reached the server fixed (boss rewards, Saria's gift, Zelda's Letter, a token beside a chest).

Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.3 fixes a crash when leaving Kokiri Forest: the client's memory page collided with one TriAevum maps for scenes with many objects. Savestates from older builds should not be loaded.
Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.2: quick text (instant boxes, hold B to skip), received items survive reloads and savestates, and the Options Creator shows only supported options.
Nothing received is lost any more: loading a save that was not saved after an item, or loading an older savestate, gives those items again; a game save is noticed, so nothing comes twice.

Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.1: oot3d.apworld and source on GitHub. New: Archipelago switch in the F1 menu, auto-connect and reconnect, in-game messages for sent and received items, DeathLink and the goal; saving progress no longer stalls the game.
Universal Tracker no longer lists Ship of Harkinian's N64 glitch routes as glitched locations; it shows only the 3D logic.
Universal Tracker tried live against a local seed: it shows the same locations in logic as the apworld (5 at the start, 11 after a Kokiri Sword).
Universal Tracker support: the tracker can rebuild the world from the seed's slot data and show what is in logic; a test rebuilds it the same way.
The title and file selection now show an Archipelago badge with the connection state, so the Archipelago version is recognizable at a glance.
The file selection shows its files again in the developer TopScreen build: a speed barrier skipped the code that draws them on the upper screen.
DeathLink works in the game: Link's death reached another player, and a death from another player killed Link without being sent back.
Goal and DeathLink: defeating Ganon is reported to the server, and deaths are shared with other DeathLink players (tested end to end against a local server).

First real play test of Phase 4: chests gave the multiworld items with their real models (the Light Arrow from Mido's chest), nothing came twice, and an item sent by the server reached Link with the normal animation.
Optional cutscene skips: story, boss and owl cutscenes can be skipped from the F1 panel, plus an experimental intro skip. Only skips that change nothing in the logic.

Phase 4: locations now give the multiworld item (your own items with their real model), and received items reach Link through the game's own get-item animation. Host tests pass; the play test is next.
Phase 4 started: design decided with the user (server stays the source of items; own items show their real model when found), game structure offsets extracted.
Project published. Logic port finished and checked against OoT3D_Randomizer: 6 rules made stricter, no location more permissive than 3D across 7 seeds.
Phase 2: the client reaches a local Archipelago server, sends a check and receives an item.
Phase 1: first play test, 19 checks logged; chests and NPC offers detected.
